claim: A lifecycle-qualified bounded digest reaches the real research CLI/prompt, is requalified at consumption, and never replaces authored notes; failed publication remains retryable
remote_verification: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/feat/autoresearch-v1 matched both full fix SHAs after successful pushes

red.cause: Digest ranks raw artifacts without authoritative lifecycle, shared secondary ordering or correctly scoped database resolution
Periodic generation replaces notes and consumes its interval even when publication fails
Nonterminal artifacts appear as failures, raw failures lack qualification labels and malformed objective declarations acquire guessed defaults
Actual role command, CLI and prompt do not deliver the current qualified automatic digest independently of historical notes
Explicit knowledge-directory loading duplicates stale automatic digest text as historical notes
Parent-relative and symlink directory aliases bypass automatic digest exclusion

red_command: Run each named file with python3 -m pytest -q TEST_FILE --tb=short from its checkout; Pro uses both source paths and explicit test-only license substitutes
green: All six frozen test files pass unchanged; legacy context-builder fixtures now supply real lifecycle authority while retaining their original assertions

final_core_regression.skip_scope: Optional Pro tests in the core-only source environment

final_pro_regression.command: PYTHONPATH=src:../orze/src CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= python3 -c 'from unittest.mock import patch; import pytest; p=patch("orze_pro._gate.require_license"); p.start(); raise SystemExit(pytest.main(["-q", "tests", "--tb=short"]))'

final_cross_repository_regression.command: Both src paths and the same test-only license patch; pytest -q tests/test_evolution.py tests/test_sweeper.py tests/test_skill_registry.py --tb=short -rs from core

independent_review: Separate core and Pro reviewers approved the final scoped diff; independent boundary tests found and verified fixes for invalid objective inputs and knowledge-path aliases
verified_boundaries: Current source metrics, taint and lifecycle changes after publication affect the actual prompt without rewriting the stored digest or notes
Periodic output is knowledge/research_digest.md; knowledge/retrospection.md and _retrospection.txt bytes are preserved
Publication uses the existing atomic helper and confirms actual bytes before advancing the interval; exceptions and silent no-op writes remain retryable
Automatic role delivery respects disabled retrospection; an explicit CLI digest request remains supported
Oversized, symlinked and wrong-project digest selections fail closed without file creation or fallback to stale text
Real producer, role-command builder, argparse, run_research_cycle and prompt builder execute in dry-run tests with a tripwire against LLM calls
limits: This proves bounded local evidence delivery, not statistical significance, research efficiency gains or a globally atomic snapshot
Legacy SOP writers/readers of _retrospection.txt are not all migrated; preserving those notes is not proof that every historical-note producer reaches every consumer
Whole-prompt budgeting, notification/steering state, champion guard policy, evaluation admission and attempt fencing remain separate open work
No production license activation, paid provider, real GPU, package publication, deployment or live campaign mutation exercised
